description: A photograph depicting a dense canopy of broadleaved trees during autumn. The foliage displays a vibrant spectrum of colours, ranging from dark green on the left, through bright yellow and various shades of orange in the middle, to deep red on the right. The trees appear to be illuminated by soft sunlight, possibly from a late afternoon or early morning angle. The sky above is partially covered with clouds, featuring darker grey clouds in the upper portion and lighter, brighter clouds just above the tree line.
